servinfo.title: Air Bag System Construction
servinfo.ptxt: There are two types of air bag system in this model, 8-channel air bag system and 10-channel air bag system, depending on vehicle specification.

servinfosub.title: Main Components of 8-Channel Air Bag System

item.ptxt: Driver and passenger air bag (inflator) modules
Driver and passenger side-air bag (inflator) modules
Driver and passenger front seat belt pretensioners
Driver and passenger curtain air bag (inflator) modules
Driver and passenger front side-impact G sensors
Driver and passenger rear side-impact G sensors

servinfosub.title: Main Components of 10-Channel Air Bag System

item.ptxt: Driver and passenger air bag (inflator) modules
Driver and passenger side-air bag (inflator) modules
Driver and passenger front seat belt pretensioners
Driver and passenger curtain air bag (inflator) modules
Left-side and right-side rear seat belt pretensioners
Driver and passenger front side-impact pressure sensors
Driver and passenger rear side-impact G sensors

servinfo.ptxt: To supplement protection offered by seat belts, the air bag system includes the following air bags: front air bags for driver and passenger seats, side-air bags for driver and passenger seats, and driver and passenger curtain air bags.
In addition to these air bags, the system also includes front seat belt pretensioners and rear seat belt pretensioners at right and left sides (10-channel air bag system).

In the event of a frontal collision with an impact larger than the preset level, the front air bag (inflator) modules (stowed in the center of the steering wheel for the driver seat and under the top of instrument panel for passenger seat) are deployed. In the event of a sideward impact exceeding the preset level, the driver and passenger side-air bag inflator modules as well as the curtain air bag inflator module (stowed in each side of roof) on the impact side are deployed.

The front seat belt pretensioners and rear seat belt pretensioners (10-channel air bag system) are activated whenever a frontal or sideward impact exceeding the preset level is detected to take up the sag in the seat belts.

The air bag system may be equipped with the passenger air bag deactivation switch. When this switch is set to “OFF” position, the front air bag for passenger seat is deactivated. This function is useful for mounting a child restraint on the passenger seat.

entry.ptxt: Rear seat belt pretensioner (10-channel air bag system)

servinfo.ptxt: The air bag system is designed to activate only in severe frontal and sideward collisions. It is not designed to activate in rear impacts, rollovers, or minor frontal and sideward collisions; it would offer no protection in these types of accidents.
